inspiration.observed_pattern: JSON_OBJECTAGG embeds JSON_OBJECT values verbatim, so nested JSON documents retain their object structure and SQL NULL members remain JSON null values.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independent service-settings report. Each service aggregates property keys into nested JSON_OBJECT documents with nullable descriptions and numeric limits; grouped service ordering and unique keys make nested null propagation observable without copying the source schema or values.

fixture_notes: Service 601 has a NULL description and service 602 has a non-NULL description; JSON_OBJECT must preserve the NULL member as JSON null inside each aggregated nested object.
determinism_notes: Service IDs, property keys, descriptions, numeric limits, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE service_settings (service_id INT NOT NULL, setting_key VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, setting_description VARCHAR(64) NULL, setting_limit INT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (service_id, setting_key))

steps.sql: SELECT service_id, JSON_OBJECTAGG(setting_key, JSON_OBJECT('description', setting_description, 'limit', setting_limit)) AS settings FROM service_settings GROUP BY service_id ORDER BY service_id

checks.sql: SELECT service_id, COUNT(*) AS setting_count FROM service_settings GROUP BY service_id ORDER BY service_id
